tests: Kupiec unconditional coverage; Christoffersen first-order independence and conditional coverage on uninterrupted 5-minute transitions
pvalue_warning: Asymptotic tests; dependence, regime variation, forecast estimation, multiple comparisons, and large sample sizes affect interpretation. Rejecting null does not prove economic significance.
joint_score: ((loss - VaR) * I(loss > VaR) / q + VaR) / ES + log(ES) - 1, with q=.01, positive loss VaR/ES. Compare means only for identical observations and units.
important: No causality attribution to economic news; timestamps alone are insufficient. No model refitting in this module.
